data.title: Pflegekasse: Pflegegrad 3 decision for Edith Musterquell
data.summary: The Pflegekasse bei der Musterquell Krankenkasse informs Bastian Musterquell that, based on the Medizinischer Dienst's assessment of 3 November 2026, his mother Edith Musterquell has been granted care level 3 (Pflegegrad 3) effective 1 October 2026. She will receive a monthly care allowance (Pflegegeld) of €599 as long as Bastian and his sister provide the home care.
data.explanation: This is a decision (Bescheid) from the Pflegekasse about your mother's care level. She now qualifies for Pflegegrad 3 and a monthly care allowance of €599, paid as long as you and your sister care for her at home; if you hire a professional care service instead, it bills the Pflegekasse directly. If you disagree with the assigned care level, you may file an objection (Widerspruch); the app shows the deadline for this. If you take no action, the decision becomes final after that period.
